CLASSIC_SOL61 / 51 CABINETS. ONE ARCADE.Expansion roadmap
WELCOME TO THE ARCADE

Your next high score starts here.

  1. Choose a cabinet and power it on.

    Wait for the original machine to finish its boot sequence.

  2. Press 5 to insert a coin, then 1 to start.

    Click the game screen first so the cabinet receives your keys. Use the player slots shown beside each cabinet for multiplayer. Mortal Kombat II, NBA Jam TE, Marvel vs. Capcom, and Progear need two credits per player with their original coinage.

  3. Follow the controls beside the screen.

    Each cabinet’s controls appear beside its screen. Centipede also uses your mouse as a trackball.

Keyboard or a gamepad is recommended for the expanded cabinets. Touch controls vary by game. The cabinet toolbar offers pause, volume, and control remapping.

 CLASSIC_SOL61

Keep the originals original.

This arcade runs original arcade software through the open-source EmulatorJS and FinalBurn Neo and MAME hardware emulators. Title screens, attract mode, intermissions, levels, and game-over screens come from the games themselves.

The cabinet around the games is new. Sharp pixels is the default; the optional scanline effect changes only the display.

These are the arcade releases, including the Midway US edition of Pac-Man, the standard-speed Ms. Pac-Man, and all four Donkey Kong stage types. Cabinet revisions can have small differences.

Emulation can differ from original hardware in timing and trackball input. This project is an emulated arcade, rather than new game-code remakes.
